name: maganghub-logbook-dashboard
description: Dashboard lokal untuk generate, edit, dan kelola Logbook MagangHub Kemnaker

scripts.build: npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.start: nodemon --watch server.js --watch lib --watch public --ignore logbook.json --ignore logbook-cache.json --ignore push-subscriptions.json --ignore push-last-sent.json --ignore .env server.js
